briefdescription.para: Returns the command line option that selects the build command.

detaileddescription.para: Reads the manifest named by --build, the weight table named by --weight and that weight's glyph sheet, and writes the font file named by --out, relative to the current directory. The written bytes are then loaded back through FreeType and checked against the document that produced them, so a font that does not round-trip fails the command instead of reaching the caller.

parameterdescription.para: The parsed command line arguments; must carry --build, --weight and --out.
